notes:
The dot on a departed, turnover or moved room now looks over the whole stay, not tonight's report alone: if any department report loaded here since that reservation arrived carried a receipt under its name on its room, the pill is dotted.

Each loaded report leaves behind only the room and guest name of its live receipts, by night, for sixty nights — no amounts, no serials. A night whose report was never loaded into RecCheck is unknown to it, and the dot says nothing about that night.
